owner: W1-19 round 2 — the main quest, end to end
title: The quay side at Soulrest, an hour after noon, with the reading room behind the Court's mark and a cart standing on the coast road. The round-1 verdict on this piece said a player who boots the build and walks to Soulrest cannot start the main quest. There was no Soulrest to walk to: no named state in game/data/states/** put Undersexton Aveline Rell or any of the three people Q-MAIN-01 names in `opens_by.overheard_from` anywhere a player could stand. This is that place, and it is the state the findability probe loads.
note: Four of these five are in `game/data/npcs/mainline.json` already; nothing here invents a person. Nerien Vass, Falus Grey and Eeja-Sul are the three `opens_by.overheard_from` NPCs of Q-MAIN-01 — greeting any one of them teaches `the drowned tally`, which is the only route into the chain that owes nothing to a prior quest. Ojal-Weeth is here because Q-MAIN-09 names her too, and because a mortuary hand outside the door is the picture.
